title: Sorting socks
description: Students sort a pile of socks and name the rule they used.
summary: Introduces sorting by an attribute — colour, then size.

sections.label: Warm-up: odd sock out
sections.section: Show four socks; students say which one does not belong and why.
Students sort the class pile by colour, then by size.

sections.label: Stretch: two rules at once
sections.section: Sort by colour and size together.

learning_intentions: Understand that a sort needs a rule
success_criteria: I can sort socks by colour
I can name the rule I used ≥ once

references.citation: Hosiery Council. (2025). *Odd socks: A national count*.
references.used_for: Section 1: one sock in five has lost its pair.

references.citation: Sock counts invented for the sorting task.
